status: frozen before adapter validation and all mechanism timing outcomes
purpose: Isolate full-score sorting from support-restricted event integration using the identical immutable compiled sparse kernel.
primary_hypothesis: Replacing global score sorting with support-score binning can reduce preprocessing time when support is sparse; the finite grid is allowed to show ties or reversals.
dense_comparator: Per-case minimum median elapsed time among the three dense methods; all raw timings and identities retained.
labels: For P=round(n*density) and K intervals, split P into K lengths differing by at most one. Center one interval in each deterministic equal-width cell [floor(j*n/K),floor((j+1)*n/K)).
exclusions: Only cells with K>P are infeasible. Exclude those before any outcomes; no outcome-based removal or replacement.
scores: Independent standard normal float64 vector from numpy.default_rng(SeedSequence([seed,n,density_index,K])). Reuse the same vector for all four widths of each layout.
randomization: Shuffle all feasible cases once; independently shuffle the five method calls inside each case and repetition.
adapter: Copy identical non-score preprocessing from _prepare. Keep support np.unique and group inversion. Replace support-bin search/bincount with np.sort(scores), followed by searchsorted(sorted_scores,support_values,right/left) to obtain exact before/after counts. Do not invoke _prepare inside the adapter.
timed_scope: End-to-end method call, including input validation, interval/support construction, score preprocessing and integration. Excludes data generation, first-call warmup, parity checks and plotting.
warmup: Call all five methods on the same fixed small input before timing; record each warmup duration separately.

validation.preprocessing: All 12 returned arrays must equal original _prepare exactly, including tie counts and support_index.
validation.integration: All five methods must agree to absolute 1e-11 with finite outputs on all validation and timed cases.
validation.failure_policy: Preserve failure receipt and abort; no exclusion or retuning.

reporting.support_density: Measure realized maximum-support Q/n and unique support-score count separately from requested positive-label density. Expansion can make support dense.
reporting.interpretation: Finite deterministic synthetic mechanism study; no population confidence interval, universal speedup, or new SOTA claim.
